svg.title: Conceptual protocol: data roles and threshold-transfer loss decomposition (Claude audit proposal, not results)
svg.text: CONCEPTUAL DIAGRAM: proposed data roles (Claude audit, Phase 0). No measured values.
Fit / select (labels allowed)
Frozen τ* applied to held-out tests
Reported per condition
BDD100K train, clear daytime
detector fine-tuning only
BDD100K val, clear, calibration half
R_max check, τ* for target R*, calibrators
ACDC train (per condition)
only for condition-aware (Mondrian) variants
BDD100K val, clear, test half (in-domain)
ACDC reference val (normal, matched routes)
ACDC val: fog / night / rain / snow
ACDC test labels are withheld (ACDC v5 §3.2).
dataset shift: BDD clear → ACDC ref
condition shift: ACDC ref → adverse
Loss decomposition at target recall R* (proposed; methodology_objections.md O4)
R_max,c = recall at score → 0 on condition c (capped by max_det/queries, NMS, object size)
Unrecoverable U_c = max(0, R* − R_max,c) Threshold transfer T_c = min(R*, R_max,c) − Recall_c(τ*)
Infeasible if R_max on the calibration half < R* + 0.02. Primary class: VRU-human = pedestrian ∪ rider (O2).
